regions.prompt:
Image1 is a low-resolution crop of ONE REGION of a continuous Rift Hunters game map whose layout has been

APPROVED and FROZEN by the owner. Repaint this exact region at high definition with genuinely NEW FINE MATERIAL DETAIL,

not interpolated blurry pixels. Image2 is the strict art-quality AND SCALE reference: an extract of the Waterfall Ruins

map at the SAME ZOOM as image1. Every paving stone, grass tuft, pebble, leaf cluster, plank and masonry block in your

output must have the SAME SIZE ON SCREEN as in image2 (paving stones about 1/40 of the image width, never larger;

the hero character of the game would be about 1/30 of the image width tall). If image1 shows coarse oversized paving

or blobs, subdivide them into many small stones of image2's size; never enlarge details.

LOCK the layout: camera, terrain outlines, path widths, water edges, cliff lines, the OUTER footprint of every forest,

rock or ruin mass, the position and footprint of every landmark (bridge, stairs, building, gate, hollow tree, altar

base) and road endpoints: overlaid on image1 your result must match it shape for shape. Do NOT narrow or widen any

road, ford or clearing, and put NOTHING on open walkable ground: it stays empty and flat, with ONLY fine surface

texture (short grass strokes, earth grain, small paving joints and cracks).

SCALE IS SET HERE: inside those locked footprints, redraw every individual object at image2's size. One oversized tree

becomes a cluster of several normal-size trees filling the same footprint; one giant rock becomes several rocks and

fine cliff blocks; one huge paving slab becomes many small cobbles; a landmark keeps its footprint but is rebuilt with

smaller, more numerous components (stones, planks, tiles, branches).

Rebuild existing stone with many fine crisp weathered masonry blocks, foliage with tiny distinct leaf clusters and

branches, timber with fine grain and joinery, water with fine ripples and foam.

Preserve the exact silhouettes and color distribution along all four edges: this region overlaps its neighbours.

Same overhead game camera, top-left light, palette of image1. Match image2's fine graphic fantasy game finish:

precise dark accents, rich natural colors. NOT smooth plastic or cartoon forms, NOT blurry, NOT an upscale, NOT

photorealistic, NOT coarse pixels. Output full-bleed, same aspect ratio as image1, maximum resolution (at least

1254 pixels on the long side). No text, characters, UI, watermark, frame or border.




THIS IS FINAL MAP25. Exactly match the APPROVED palette and silhouettes: five chapter fragments, dark violet void and eye swirls, NOT one uniform biome. The abyss stays deep empty space, not floor. The material scale must match image2: small15-26worldunit paving,12-16unit stair depth, tiny fine frost, ash, roots and crystalline cliff facets.
The four arena covers MUST remain INSIDE the playing field, at their current approved foot locations; never move them to the sides, never remove or duplicate them. Every ordinary solid cover body should be compact110-160worldunits (target140, roughly9%of a1574unit-wide region); if the coarse composition shows an oversized body, rebuild ONE smaller coherent body about140units wide INSIDE that footprint, same foot position, restore flat fine floor around it. No sprawling large rubble and no extra cover. The six glowing crystal-anchor pillars stay at the outer rim, width110-140units. Keep boss spawn middle empty; NO circle or boss painted. Do not turn the internal four blocks back into an entirely empty arena.
All marked chapter surfaces—shallow fords, hot crust, mud, smooth ice and corruption—remain FLAT WALKABLE floor, no new pit, ridge or waterbank. Keep their existing footprints. Image1 is a low-resolution crop of ONE REGION of a continuous Rift Hunters game map whose layout has been

APPROVED and FROZEN by the owner. Repaint this exact region at high definition with genuinely NEW FINE MATERIAL DETAIL,

not interpolated blurry pixels. Image2 is the strict art-quality AND SCALE reference: an extract of the Waterfall Ruins

map at the SAME ZOOM as image1. Every paving stone, grass tuft, pebble, leaf cluster, plank and masonry block in your

output must have the SAME SIZE ON SCREEN as in image2 (paving stones about 1/40 of the image width, never larger;

the hero character of the game would be about 1/30 of the image width tall). If image1 shows coarse oversized paving

or blobs, subdivide them into many small stones of image2's size; never enlarge details.

LOCK the layout: camera, terrain outlines, path widths, water edges, cliff lines, the OUTER footprint of every forest,

rock or ruin mass, the position and footprint of every landmark (bridge, stairs, building, gate, hollow tree, altar

base) and road endpoints: overlaid on image1 your result must match it shape for shape. Do NOT narrow or widen any

road, ford or clearing, and put NOTHING on open walkable ground: it stays empty and flat, with ONLY fine surface

texture (short grass strokes, earth grain, small paving joints and cracks).

SCALE IS SET HERE: inside those locked footprints, redraw every individual object at image2's size. One oversized tree

becomes a cluster of several normal-size trees filling the same footprint; one giant rock becomes several rocks and

fine cliff blocks; one huge paving slab becomes many small cobbles; a landmark keeps its footprint but is rebuilt with

smaller, more numerous components (stones, planks, tiles, branches).

Rebuild existing stone with many fine crisp weathered masonry blocks, foliage with tiny distinct leaf clusters and

branches, timber with fine grain and joinery, water with fine ripples and foam.

Preserve the exact silhouettes and color distribution along all four edges: this region overlaps its neighbours.

Same overhead game camera, top-left light, palette of image1. Match image2's fine graphic fantasy game finish:

precise dark accents, rich natural colors. NOT smooth plastic or cartoon forms, NOT blurry, NOT an upscale, NOT

photorealistic, NOT coarse pixels. Output full-bleed, same aspect ratio as image1, maximum resolution (at least

1254 pixels on the long side). No text, characters, UI, watermark, frame or border.




THIS IS FINAL MAP25. Exactly match the APPROVED palette and silhouettes: five chapter fragments, dark violet void and eye swirls, NOT one uniform biome. The abyss stays deep empty space, not floor. Give existing nebula swirls fine natural electric filaments and tiny glints in their existing footprint, without uniform noise or new terrain. No new debris bridges or islands. The material scale must match image2: small15-26worldunit paving,12-16unit stair depth, tiny fine frost, ash, roots and crystalline cliff facets.
The four arena covers MUST remain INSIDE the playing field, at their current approved foot locations; never move them to the sides, never remove or duplicate them. Every ordinary solid cover body should be compact110-160worldunits (target140, roughly9%of a1574unit-wide region); if the coarse composition shows an oversized body, rebuild ONE smaller coherent body about140units wide INSIDE that footprint, same foot position, restore flat fine floor around it. No sprawling large rubble and no extra cover. The six glowing crystal-anchor pillars stay at the outer rim, width110-140units. Keep boss spawn middle empty; NO circle or boss painted. Do not turn the internal four blocks back into an entirely empty arena.
All marked chapter surfaces—shallow fords, hot crust, mud, smooth ice and corruption—remain FLAT WALKABLE floor, no new pit, ridge or waterbank. Keep their existing footprints. Existing narrow welds and southwest final neck join BOTH neighboring floors; no wall, high threshold or obstacle at either mouth. Preserve the route widths and endpoints. Solid foundation walls and void edges remain unmistakably blocked.
Output square at least1254x1254 native. Any black padding at extreme edges is outside the world and will be cropped; do not shift content to fill it. Do not print labels or characters. Fresh FINE ART, never simply sharpen or interpolate the crop.
Region r3_1, exact square span1574worldunits. Image2 is Ruins at the SAME units-per-pixel. A52unit hunter here is3.30%of image width. Existing cover feet in or just outside this crop (keep partial objects at edges, never drag them inside): a01 foot at -3.7%x,-4.4%y; a03 foot at 15.6%x,39.8%y.
Existing violet nebula clouds: replace broad blurry concept shading with genuinely fine interwoven plasma filaments and tiny faceted energy ripples at5–12worldunit scale within the approved light bands. Keep their flowing directions and dark void gaps. No uniform noise or stars used as a filter, no new solid terrain. The void must remain void, with coherent detailed painted energy rather than a smooth plastic gradient.
